hooks.prompt: If the file just written or edited ends in .jl (a Julia source file) and a Julia REPL session is active (i.e., you have previously called eval, session, or any julia-repl MCP tool in this conversation), call the revise MCP tool with action='revise' to hot-reload the changes into the active Julia session. This preserves session state and avoids needing a reset. Do NOT call revise for non-.jl files or if no Julia session has been started yet.

If the eval result contains rich visual output — Unicode plots (Braille characters ⠀-⣿), tables, matrices, DataFrames, or multi-line structured output — paste the complete output directly into your response as raw text (NOT inside a code block) so ANSI terminal colors are preserved. Do NOT paste simple scalar results (numbers, short strings, booleans, nothing) or error messages.
